description: This Java class 'AndroidInlineLayoutProcessor' handles refactoring operations for inlining Android layout files within an IDE, including finding usages, performing refactoring, and conflict detection.

classes.name: AndroidInlineLayoutProcessor
classes.description: Handles inlining of Android layout files during refactoring, including usage detection, conflict resolution, and file modifications.

methods.name: createUsageViewDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a descriptor for the usage view during refactoring.

methods.name: findUsages
methods.description: Finds all usages of the layout file and related resources for inlining.

methods.name: performRefactoring
methods.description: Performs the actual inlining refactoring based on identified usages.

methods.name: detectConflicts
methods.description: Analyzes usages to identify potential conflicts.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name for the refactoring operation.

methods.name: getUndoConfirmationPolicy
methods.description: Specifies undo confirmation policy for the refactoring.
